Team — forwarding Kellan's note and my takeaways from the discovery. Key asks: clear $/1M token buckets for procurement + ops delta vs self-hosting. They want 3 conservative/balanced/diy rows and a short justification.

My read: EdgeHealth is very price-sensitive but can't tolerate operational risk (medical triage product). They'll prioritize reliability and support but will weigh cost versus model quality. They mentioned wanting model parity vs Anthropic H2 / OpenAI sob models for hallucination behavior.

Proposed candidate price buckets (initial suggestion) — short bullets for Deck: 
- Conservative (Dedicated Redwood Dedicated / reserved pools + SLA + on-call): $1,050 / 1M tokens. Covers reserved GPUs, higher priority routing, 24x7 escalation. (~30–80M baseline).
- Balanced (Hosted Redwood, priority tier + automatic KV caching): $520 / 1M tokens. Good tradeoff: lower unit cost via multi-tenant pooling and caching, still SLA-backed for critical routes.
- DIY-hosted (self-hosted open models, infra + ops): $260 / 1M tokens (infra cost estimate only; excludes 24x7 ops, model patching, audit logs).

Quick comparative notes to include in the table: 
- OpenAI (hosted): comparable feature set for their managed models but list price for our comparison reference ~ $720–$1,200 / 1M tokens depending on model family (we'll map model families in the slide).
- Anthropic (hosted): in the same ballpark as OpenAI for comparable safety/quality models — typically a premium versus small open-model hosts.
- Self-hosting vendors (RunPod/Replicate/Cloud GPU rental): raw infra looks cheaper per million tokens, but operational burden (patching, quantization, KV cache, rollout testing) typically adds 20–40% hidden cost and delays.

Attachments I'm preparing: EdgeHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (their MAP + token estimates) and a compact one-page Redwood Price Buckets (redwood-price-buckets-v2.pdf).

Next steps for us:
1) Marcus — can you run a quick capacity-driven cost calc for the Balanced bucket (assume 60M tokens/mo baseline, 120M on peak) + note where caching buys down cost? Need by EOD Tue.
2) Laura — compile a 1-pager ops-delta (bullet list) comparing Redwood Hosted vs self-hosted for procurement (onboarding, SOC2 evidence, patching, support SLAs). Need by Wed.
3) I'll schedule 30m with Kellan + Aisha for Fri to present the buckets and walk procurement.

I'll include the pricing table and a short 1-slide justification when we sync.

Thanks — Neha

- Baseline throughput: 60M tokens/mo -> ~2.0 tokens/sec steady across 30-day window (with typical diurnal patterns).
- With continuous batching + KV prefix caching we estimate ~35–45% effective token cost reduction on conversational flows (EdgeHealth use-case).

Assumptions and notes attached. I'm comfortable recommending we present $520 / 1M as the balanced list price and show line items that justify the delta to the customer (caching, routing, SLA).
